sources.message: Using public sample key (10 real UP records, all districts) because primary key failed: HTTP Error 403: Forbidden — { "error": "Key not authorised" } — Possible reasons: key invalid / not verified / expired / email verification pending. Troubleshoot: 1) data.gov.in → My Account → verify email (click verification link). 2) Copy key again without spaces. 3) In GitHub repo → Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions → pencil icon on DATA_GOV_IN_API_KEY → paste → Save. 4) Actions tab → Multi-Daily Mandi Price Update → Run workflow.
